name: Plant Pathology 2020: Foliar Disease of Apples Benchmark
description: The Plant Pathology 2020 dataset is an expert-curated foliar disease image benchmark created by Cornell University and Cornell AgriTech in collaboration with the CVPR 2020 Fine-Grained Visual Categorization (FGVC7) workshop. The dataset comprises 3,651 high-resolution images of apple tree leaves (Malus domestica) exhibiting complex symptoms of foliar diseases photographed in real-world commercial orchards. Annotations classify each leaf into one of four mutually exclusive diagnostic categories: healthy, apple scab (Venturia inaequalis), cedar apple rust (Gymnosporangium juniperi-virginianae), and leaves displaying multiple co-occurring diseases. The dataset supports fine-grained visual classification, multi-task learning, and robust disease severity diagnostics.
